implementation_notes: Gems or directories with a single entry-point file; `private`/`private_constant` shrink the surface. Avoid reopening classes from other modules — that is a dependency edge no require graph records.
idiom_name: gem or directory + single entry file + private internals
code_sketch:
# lib/pricing.rb — the only entry point
require_relative 'pricing/calculator'
module Pricing
  Calculator = Pricing::Internal::Calculator
  private_constant :Internal
end
pitfalls: `class String; ...; end` monkey patches — invisible coupling
Gems that re-export everything through one global namespace module
